annotations.title: Find current job openings with their pay

description: Current job openings in the US and Canada from employers' own job boards and US federal announcements from USAJOBS (read through their documented APIs, refreshed weekly), matching keywords and a place. Each result: title and employer as posted, places, posting date, the pay range when available in the feed, and otherwise the official BLS median for the occupation in the US state named (national for US remote jobs); for published US ranges, where the range sits on the official distribution; and the link to apply on the employer's own site. Results are newest first or by published pay. Coverage is strongest for technology, finance, startups and remote work; many hospitals, retailers and state and local governments are not included yet, so few or no results does not mean no such jobs exist. No job descriptions; FedSalary takes no applications.

federal_only.description: true = only US federal job announcements (from USAJOBS; apply on USAJOBS).

keywords.description: A full official occupation name searches all openings classified in it. Other keywords are matched against the employer and job title.

min_pay.description: Annualized pay threshold. The default is USD equivalent. With pay_currency CAD, compare only Canadian postings quoted in CAD. Jobs without published pay are left out when this is set.

occupation.description: Optional US SOC code, Canadian NOC code or official occupation name. Combine with keywords to narrow the occupation by employer or specialty.

pay_basis.description: With min_pay, require the published annual minimum (year) or hourly minimum (hour, compared to min_pay / 2,080). Omit for the top of the annualized range.

pay_currency.description: CAD requires pay quoted in Canadian dollars. USD keeps the default USD-equivalent comparison.

place.description: A US state (texas or TX), a US metro area or large city (austin), remote (US remote jobs), canada, a Canadian province (ontario) or a large Canadian city (toronto). Leave out for everywhere.

posted_after.description: Include only openings with an employer posting date after YYYY-MM-DD.

published_pay_only.description: true = only jobs that publish a pay range.

remote_only.description: true = only jobs the employer marks remote, on top of any place (remote jobs open to Texas: place texas, remote_only true). For remote jobs anywhere in the US, set place to remote instead.

schedule.description: Require an employer-stated full-time or part-time schedule.

strictly_above.description: With min_pay, exclude equality for an explicit request for pay over the amount.
